summary.en:
- Welt is a general support that can also be played as the 4th party member substituting a sustain thanks to his delays and SPD reduction. He can also be played as a main DPS, preferably at higher eidolons.
- He reduces enemies SPD and from his Ultimate applies the "Weightless" state which not only delays enemies on hit, but also is the main source of his amplification.
- Welt may struggle against multiple waves of enemies, notably in Pure Fiction, as the large amount of enemies entering lowers the uptime on his debuffs.
- Although Welt can delay enemies, he is not a dedicated sustain character.
- Welt can cast his Ultimate between an enemy's action and their extra action(s), which will cancel the extra action(s).

details.en:
- E4 reduces the All-Type RES of all enemies under the "Weightless" state by 30%.
- E2 generates 3 extra energy for Welt every time he attacks a Slowed enemy, greatly speeding up his Ultimate recovery.
- E6 grants Welt 30% CRIT Rate and 60% CRIT DMG for attacks against Slowed enemies.
